_meta.indication: To reduce the risk of sustained eGFR decline, end-stage kidney disease, cardiovascular death, and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with chronic kidney disease at risk of progression (this s024 supplement added the CKD indication)

pivotal_trials.design: International, multicenter, event-driven, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial comparing dapagliflozin 10 mg once daily with placebo
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with CKD: eGFR between ≥25 and ≤75 mL/min/1.73m2 and urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (UACR) ≥200 and ≤5000 mg/g on a maximally tolerated daily dose of an ACEi or ARB
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint: composite of a sustained ≥50% decline in eGFR, ESKD (sustained eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73m2, chronic dialysis, or kidney transplant), CV death, and renal death
pivotal_trials.result: Primary endpoint reached by 197 (9.2%) dapagliflozin vs 312 (14.5%) placebo patients after median 28.5 months (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.51, 0.72; 2-sided p < 0.0001). Secondary: HF hospitalization or CV death HR 0.71 (95% CI 0.55, 0.92; p = 0.009); all-cause death HR 0.69 (95% CI 0.53, 0.88; p = 0.0035)

key_safety: No new adverse reactions identified in DAPA-CKD; most common adverse reactions (≥5% incidence) across the program were female genital mycotic infections, nasopharyngitis, and urinary tract infections. Key warnings include ketoacidosis in patients with diabetes and volume depletion/hypotension.
target_moa: Oral inhibitor of sodium glucose co-transporter 2 (SGLT2)

advisory_committee.vote: No Advisory Committee meeting was convened for this application; it did not raise significant issues regarding safety or effectiveness.

description.text: Added efficacy/safety data for dapagliflozin 10 mg as add-on to combination of metformin and sulfonylurea in Type 2 diabetes

citations.quote: This “Prior Approval” supplemental new drug application provides for addition of data to the package insert from study D1693C00005 entitled, *A 24-week, multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, international Phase III study with a 28-week extension period to evaluate the safety and efficacy of dapagliflozin 10mg once daily in patients with Type 2 diabetes who have inadequate glycemic control on a background combination of metformin and sulfonylurea*, and for a minor change to the Medication Guide.

description.text: Added efficacy data for concomitant initiation of exenatide once weekly plus dapagliflozin in type 2 diabetes inadequately controlled on metformin

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application proposes to include the efficacy data from the following exenatide dapagliflozin clinical study: DURATION 8 (D5553C0003), *A 28-week, multi-centre, randomised, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study with a 24-week extension phase followed by a 52-week extension phase to evaluate the efficacy and safety of concomitant initiation of exenatide once weekly 2 mg and dapagliflozin once daily 10 mg compared to exenatide once weekly 2 mg alone and dapagliflozin once daily 10 mg alone in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) who have inadequate glycemic control on metformin.*

description.text: Updated labeling to allow use in patients with eGFR of 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 or greater with no dose adjustment (moderate renal impairment/CKD 3A)

citations.quote: These Prior Approval sNDAs provide for changes to the current Prescribing Information to reflect that no dose adjustment is needed for patients with an estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 or greater as supported by Clinical Study Report D1690C00024, entitled, "A Multicenter, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel Group, Randomized, Phase III Study to Evaluate the Glycemic Efficacy and Renal Safety of Dapagliflozin in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Moderate Renal Impairment (CKD 3A) Who Have Inadequate Glycemic Control."

description.text: Added cardiovascular outcomes data from the DECLARE trial to labeling for dapagliflozin products

citations.quote: These Prior Approval supplemental new drug applications provide for revisions to labeling based on the results of Study D1693C0001, Dapagliflozin Effect on Cardiovascular Events (DECLARE), which was conducted to assess cardiovascular outcomes and to assess the risk of bladder cancer associated with dapagliflozin.

description.text: Expanded type 2 diabetes mellitus glycemic control indication to include pediatric patients aged 10 years and older

citations.quote: These Prior Approval sNDAs provide for the expansion of the approved indication as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus to include pediatric patients aged 10 years and older, with associated revisions to the Farxiga and Xigduo XR Prescribing Information and Medication Guides based on the results of the pediatric study D1680C00019 (CV181375) entitled, A 26-week, multicenter, randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind, parallel group, phase 3 trial with a 26-week safety extension period evaluating the safety and efficacy of dapagliflozin 5 and 10 mg, and saxagliptin 2.5 and 5 mg in pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus who are between 10 and below 18 years of age.

summary.text: This s024 prior-approval efficacy supplement added the chronic kidney disease indication for Farxiga (dapagliflozin), an oral SGLT2 inhibitor, based on the DAPA-CKD trial. It received Priority review and Breakthrough Therapy Designation (granted 30-Sept-2020); no Advisory Committee was convened. It was a traditional (full) approval, not accelerated approval.
